_about: Public-domain William Sanday (1843-1920, Lady Margaret Professor of Divinity at Oxford) for the Word Hoard: The Gospels in the Second Century (1876) and The Criticism of the Fourth Gospel (1905) from Project Gutenberg, and 18 more from Internet Archive scans, 1872-1920, among them Inspiration (Bampton Lectures, 1893), Outlines of the Life of Christ, Christologies Ancient and Modern (1910) and Personality in Christ (1911). His joint ICC Romans with Headlam is left off as joint work. Raw OCR. Added 2026-10-17 by lane A, round 23 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. No uids minted.
